title: Apam a Ɛto nsa frɛɛ Ɔsɛe
intro: Fa no sɛ wɔabɔ wo ho ban wɔ ɔdan biako ase sɛ adiyisɛm, nanso wopaw nokwaredi soronko. Saa onipa yi traa ase bɛn nokware ne nkɔmhyɛyɛ kɛse, nanso ɔdan kɔɔ wɔn a wɔpow no so. Wɔn asɛm no gyina hɔ sɛ kɔkɔbɔ a anibere wom sɛ trenee a wɔbɛn no nkutoo ntumi nnye ɔkra a oyi ahotoso no ma no nkwa.
clues: Metenaa nkɔmhyɛni bi a Allah ayi no fie.
Ná minim nokware a me kunu ka no, nanso na minnye nni ankasa.
Miyii ne mu ahotoso no mae denam ne nkurɔfo a wɔpow no afã a migyinae na meboaa wɔn tiaa no no so.
Wɔka me ho asɛm ka odiyifo foforo hokafo a ɔno nso yii mae no ho, sɛ nhwɛso ma atiafo.
Wɔaka m’asɛm wɔ Surah At-Tahrim mu sɛ kɔkɔbɔ sɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda adiyifoɔ ntam no mma ahobanbɔ biara.
Me ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no sɛee berɛ a Allah sɛee Lut nkurofoɔ, a wɔgyaa wɔn wɔ wɔn a wɔaka no nkyɛn no.

identity.label: Meyɛ Henanom?
options: Ɔkɔmhyɛni Lut Yere
Asiya, Farao Yere
Imran Yere no
Sarah, Ɔkɔmhyɛni Ibrahim Yere

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Oyii odiyifo no mae denam atiafoa a ɔboaa wɔn tiaa no no so
Tow akokoaa bi gu asubɔnten no mu wɔ kɛntɛn mu de gye no nkwa
Ɔhwehwɛɛ sɛ wosi sika nantwi ba bere a odiyifo no nni hɔ no
Ɔbɔɔ ɔsomfo trenee bi sobo sɛ wayɛ bɔne na ɔde no too afiase
Di asono dɔm bi anim ma wɔsɛee Kaaba no
trial.answer: Oyii odiyifo no mae denam atiafoa a ɔboaa wɔn tiaa no no so

Adaka a wosii wɔ ɔsoro ahyɛde ase no

location.answer: Lut nkurɔfoɔ nkuro a wɔabubu no

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Ɔne atiafo no sɛee ɛmfa ho sɛ ɔne odiyifo bi waree no
Wɔne agyidifoɔ no gyee no nkwa na ɔkɔɔ Paradise wɔ asomdwoeɛ mu
Wɔdanee no odum sɛ sɛnkyerɛnne maa awo ntoatoaso a edi hɔ no
Wɔmenee asase a ademude akɛse wom
Wɔmaa no anwonwade abofra wɔ ne nkwakoraabere mu
outcome.answer: Ɔne atiafo no sɛee ɛmfa ho sɛ ɔne odiyifo bi waree no

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
